mapper.sql: select h.health_id, h.elevator_id, h.stat_period, h.stat_start_date, h.stat_end_date, h.fault_count, h.fault_rate, h.fault_score, h.maintain_done, h.maintain_finish, h.maintain_rate, h.maintain_score, h.inspect_total, h.inspect_normal, h.inspect_rate, h.inspect_score, h.maintain_applicable, h.inspect_applicable, h.health_score, h.health_level, h.calc_time, e.elevator_code as elevator_code, e.brand as brand, e.unit_no as unit_no, b.building_no as building_no, b.community_id as community_id, c.community_name as community_name from elevator_health h left join elevator e on h.elevator_id = e.elevator_id left join building b on e.building_id = b.building_id left join community c on b.community_id = c.community_id
mapper.select: select elevator_id from elevator where del_flag = '0' order by elevator_id
mapper.insert: insert into elevator_health ( elevator_id, stat_period, stat_start_date, stat_end_date, fault_count, fault_rate, fault_score, maintain_done, maintain_finish, maintain_rate, maintain_score, inspect_total, inspect_normal, inspect_rate, inspect_score, maintain_applicable, inspect_applicable, health_score, health_level, calc_time ) values ( #{elevatorId}, #{statPeriod}, #{statStartDate}, #{statEndDate}, #{faultCount}, #{faultRate}, #{faultScore}, #{maintainDone}, #{maintainFinish}, #{maintainRate}, #{maintainScore}, #{inspectTotal}, #{inspectNormal}, #{inspectRate}, #{inspectScore}, #{maintainApplicable}, #{inspectApplicable}, #{healthScore}, #{healthLevel}, sysdate() )
mapper.delete: delete from elevator_health where elevator_id = #{elevatorId} and stat_period = #{statPeriod}
